notes: Where a publisher is, for reading a bare place of publication ("Cambridge" beside "Cambridge University Press"). A SKELETON (2026-11-15): a handful of entries to show how such background knowledge is used; it is shown at the review desk as a hint beside a publisher's records and decides nothing. Provenance: the pairing of publisher and place is written by the assistant (Claude) from general knowledge, not copied from any source; each TGN identifier was checked against the Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names (Getty Vocabularies, Open Data Commons Attribution License 1.0) as loaded in the project's local index on 2026-11-15. Additions and corrections by pull request: one entry a publisher, every name it is printed under in "names", the place as a reader would say it, the TGN identifier, and in "source" where the fact comes from. One place an entry for now: a publisher with offices in two places that both appear bare on its imprints (Yale University Press: New Haven and London) is deliberately absent until an entry can carry several.
